description: Plough field 20-25cm deep to break hardpan and expose pests to sun.
Incorporate well-rotted farmyard manure 8-10 t/ha before sowing.
Level field and form bunds/ridges as per irrigation method.
Treat seed with recommended fungicide/rhizobium culture before sowing.
Sow at recommended spacing and depth for the variety.
Ensure adequate soil moisture at sowing; irrigate if dry.
Check germination percentage 7-10 days after sowing; gap-fill if needed.
Apply light irrigation to aid establishment, avoid waterlogging.
Remove weeds competing with young seedlings.
Apply first split dose of Nitrogen as per soil test.
Irrigate at critical vegetative stage based on soil moisture/ET.
Hoe/inter-cultivate to control weeds and aerate soil.
Monitor for aphid/whitefly/jassid; apply need-based control.
Apply remaining N and K dose at flowering/pre-flowering stage.
Ensure no moisture stress during flowering - most yield-sensitive stage.
Install pheromone traps; scout and spray if ETL crossed.
Inspect for blight/rust/mildew symptoms after rain or high humidity.
Withhold irrigation 10-15 days before harvest to aid maturity/drying.
Check grain/pod moisture and visual maturity indicators.
Check for storage pests before harvest; avoid late-season sprays near harvest.
Harvest at physiological maturity to minimize shattering/quality loss.
Dry produce to safe moisture level and clean before storage/sale.
Store in proper conditions to prevent pest/fungal damage.
